Our story

About us

Kalinga NX Sports is a cricket and sports equipment store on Main Road, Umerkote, Odisha 764073, serving players and shops – wholesale and retail – with one promise: awesome cricket bats without overspending.

Passion for cricketCricket is where we started and what we know best.
Quality equipmentBats, kits, shoes, protective gear and accessories.
Sports communityGear for local players, clubs and tennis-ball cricket.
Player supportGuidance on weight, size and fit for every player.
Customer serviceDirect WhatsApp assistance, before and after you buy.
